policy: Every external semantic dependency used normatively must be pinned to an immutable specification or release artifact before publication.

dependencies.name: RDF Dataset Canonicalization (RDFC-1.0)
dependencies.role: normative canonicalization contract for fixed knowledge-snapshot materializations

dependencies.name: SPDX 2.2 RDF terms
dependencies.role: qualified distribution checksums in the DCAT catalog

dependencies.name: CIDOC CRM
dependencies.status: deferred beyond 0.1.0 pending exact-version mapping review

dependencies.name: Pipe Organ Ontology (PON)
dependencies.status: deferred beyond 0.1.0 pending exact-version mapping review

dependencies.name: MODAVIS Release 1.3 operational vocabularies
dependencies.role: implementation background, not a normative dependency
dependencies.status: no immutable public release vocabulary artifact is identified; no normative mapping is claimed in 0.1.0

dependencies.name: Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) Standard 0.4.0
dependencies.role: downstream co-release application and container profile
dependencies.status: not imported by MODAVIS; the VAO-owned 0.4.0 mapping binds to MODAVIS 0.1.0 and is released only after both immutable source tags exist

dependencies.name: ECHOES Heritage Digital Twin Ontology (HDTO) 1.1
dependencies.role: non-normative public design input and future interoperability candidate
dependencies.status: reviewed but not imported, copied, mapped, or required by MODAVIS 0.1.0; repository-level vocabulary licensing must be clarified before any term-level reuse

dependencies.name: RDF 1.2 and SHACL 1.2 draft families
dependencies.status: not normative for 0.1.0; RDF 1.2 is a Candidate Recommendation and SHACL 1.2 is a Working Draft, while this release remains on RDF 1.1 and SHACL 2017
